goal: a sensor bin whose lid opens when you wave at it, rebuilt around an ESP32
must: run on one LiPo charge for at least a month
fit inside the original Sisuo SS-01 cavity
open within half a second of a wave
prefer: reuse what I already own before buying
decided: L9110S rather than TB6612 - right current class, two inputs not three
VL6180X on I2C rather than the original IR pair
no OLED - the bin never had a screen
rangefinder and speaker live on ribbons, not on the board
the board is a DFRobot FireBeetle 2 ESP32-S3, not the XIAO ESP32-C6 on hand (2026-09-24): the C6 wakes from GPIO0-7 only, three usable pins on the XIAO; the S3 has 22
audio is an I2S amplifier (DFRobot DFR0954, MAX98357A) with tones synthesised by the ESP32, not the DFR0534 on hand (2026-09-25); which module is really in the drawer is still unconfirmed (B1)
